name: Overtime
quantity: sum(work.days.map(d, d.overtime_hours <= 0.0 ? 0.0 : ((d.day_type == "WORK" || d.day_type == "") && d.holiday_kind == "" ? ladder(d.overtime_hours, [[1.0, 1.5], [null, 2.0]]) : (terms.facts.working_days_per_week == 6.0 ? (d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours <= 5.0 ? ladder(d.overtime_hours, [[5.0, 2.0], [6.0, 3.0], [null, 4.0]]) : ladder(d.overtime_hours, [[7.0, 2.0], [8.0, 3.0], [null, 4.0]])) : ladder(d.overtime_hours, [[8.0, 2.0], [9.0, 3.0], [null, 4.0]])))))
rate: (terms.employment_type == "DAILY" && has(terms.facts.daily_wage) ? terms.facts.daily_wage * (has(terms.facts.working_days_per_week) && terms.facts.working_days_per_week == 6.0 ? 25.0 : 21.0) : (terms.monthly_wage < 0.75 * (terms.monthly_wage + (has(terms.facts.non_fixed_allowances_monthly) ? terms.facts.non_fixed_allowances_monthly : 0.0)) ? 0.75 * (terms.monthly_wage + (has(terms.facts.non_fixed_allowances_monthly) ? terms.facts.non_fixed_allowances_monthly : 0.0)) : terms.monthly_wage)) / 173.0
authority: PP 35/2021 arts.31–32: the overtime hour is 1/173 of the monthly wage (art.32(2)), on basic plus fixed allowances (art.32(3), `terms.monthly_wage`). Each day of the attendance window (`work.days`) is priced on its approved overtime hours (an order and the worker's consent, art.28): on an ordinary working day the first hour at 1.5× and every further hour at 2× (art.31(1)); on a weekly rest day or an official holiday (`holiday_kind`) every hour worked is overtime — for a 6-day / 40-hour week hours 1–7 at 2×, hour 8 at 3×, hours 9–11 at 4× (art.31(2)(a)), and when the holiday falls on the shortest working day (scheduled 5 hours or less) hours 1–5 at 2×, hour 6 at 3×, hours 7–9 at 4× (art.31(2)(b)); for a 5-day / 40-hour week hours 1–8 at 2×, hour 9 at 3×, hours 10–12 at 4× (art.31(3)). The week is the terms fact `working_days_per_week` (5 or 6); a rest-day or holiday hour without it refuses. Hours beyond the last listed hour stay at 4× (the article lists none beyond; the art.26 daily limit keeps them rare). A daily-paid worker's month is the agreed daily wage × 25 on a 6-day week or × 21 on a 5-day week (art.33(1)). No overtime wage for a golongan jabatan tertentu (art.27(2)–(3), `MANAGERIAL`) — only where the agreement, company regulation or collective agreement defines that group (art.27(4)–(5)). https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf Where basic plus fixed allowances are below 75% of the whole wage (customer input `terms.facts.non_fixed_allowances_monthly`), the base is 75% of the whole wage (art.32(4)).

name: Leave encashment
quantity: sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.can_encash && r.activity == "ENCASHMENT" && !(employment.exit_date != "" && r.from == employment.exit_date)).map(r, r.days))
eligibility: leave.rows.exists(r, r.can_encash && r.activity == "ENCASHMENT" && r.days > 0.0 && !(employment.exit_date != "" && r.from == employment.exit_date))
authority: UU 13/2003 art.79 as amended by UU 6/2023 and PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(a): unused annual leave not yet lapsed is paid. Owner ruling (ID): a day is the basic wage ÷ the entity fact `leave_cash_out_day_divisor` (20 for KDIT, as its payroll pays). In service it is ordinary income under PPh 21 TER.

name: Leave paid on termination (uang penggantian hak)
quantity: sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.can_encash && r.activity == "ENCASHMENT" && employment.exit_date != "" && r.from == employment.exit_date).map(r, r.days))
eligibility: leave.rows.exists(r, r.can_encash && r.activity == "ENCASHMENT" && r.days > 0.0 && employment.exit_date != "" && r.from == employment.exit_date)
authority: PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(a): on termination the unused, unlapsed annual leave is paid as uang penggantian hak, at the basic wage ÷ `company.facts.leave_cash_out_day_divisor` (owner ruling). PP 68/2009 art.1 angka 4: "Uang Pesangon" includes the uang penggantian hak paid because the employment ends, so it is withheld under the final PP 68/2009 art.4 bands (PPH21_FINAL_SEVERANCE), not TER. The exit encashment is the leave movement the exit behaviour writes on the last day (`r.from == employment.exit_date`).

name: Leave paid at a reduced rate
authority: Leave paid at less than the full wage: the class's `pay_fraction` per leave row (evaluated by the engine on the row's `month_index` of its absence event). UU 13/2003 art.93(3): a sick worker is paid 100% for the first four months, 75% for the next four, 50% for the next four and 25% thereafter until dismissal (MEDICAL_LEAVE); UU 4/2024 art.5(2): maternity leave is paid in full for the first four months and 75% for the fifth and sixth (MATERNITY_LEAVE). The unpaid share of each day is deducted at the basic wage ÷ the month's days.
